description: The line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small,” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance over six training epochs for four different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper small model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each whole number, indicating discrete training steps. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 25.0 to 42.5, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 2.5, representing the error rate metric. Four distinct lines are plotted: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (solid orange line with circle markers) begins at WER ≈ 35.6, peaks at epoch 2 (≈ 33.8), then declines steadily to ≈ 31.2 at epoch 6. “small AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed orange line with square markers) starts at WER ≈ 30.1, rises to a peak of ≈ 42.2 at epoch 2, then drops sharply to ≈ 25.5 by epoch 6. “small int4” (solid yellow-orange line with circle markers) begins at ≈ 30.0, dips slightly to ≈ 28.7 at epoch 2, then continues declining to ≈ 25.2 at epoch 6. “small int8” (dashed yellow-orange line with square markers) starts at ≈ 30.0, rises to ≈ 33.2 at epoch 1, then declines to ≈ 25.8 at epoch 6. All lines show non-monotonic behavior early on, with most converging toward lower WER values by epoch 6.
